newsitem.title: USA: Sony wins DIRECTV contract in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Sony wins DIRECTV contract in Japan.

text.p: Sony Electronics Inc said Sunday that it has won a contract to build a direct broadcast satellite facility for DIRECTV JAPAN Inc, a new company formed by Hughes Electronics Corp and six Japanese firms.
The company said in a release that the 100-channel facility is among the largest built in Japan and will provide subscription movies, live events, local channel programming and movies-on-demand.
The facility, the third large-scale system Sony has built for DIRECTV, is scheduled to begin broadcasting in the Fall of 1997, Sony said.
The company did not disclose an exact value for its agreement, but said it was a multimillion dollar contract.
Japanese partners in DIRECTV include Matsushita Electric Industrial Co and the Mitsubishi conglomerate.
